judgment_calls: Split L4052 into four separate nodes (n007-n010): the paragraph establishes four independently-evaluable claims (openness/generosity, avoiding condescension, collaboration without over-explaining, and voice prosody in voice mode). Each can be assessed true/false independently and appears in different contexts.

Treated each section's heading as its own node establishing guideline authority (n001, n006, n012, n020) rather than merging into the first rule under it. This preserves the location where the authority metadata is explicitly introduced and allows other rules to need it.
Kept unprompted_personal_comments_rule as a local internal name (not an inherited seed) because this concept is established within this span (n002) and only used within this span's first section.
Created avoid_condescension_rule as a named concept provided by n008 because multiple subsequent claims need it (n009 is motivated by it, n011 demonstrates it).

Created safe_complete_strategy as a provided concept (n013) because two subsequent example nodes (n017, n018) demonstrate this strategy without re-establishing it, following the ordering-node pattern where the rule is stated once and examples invoke it.

Created hard_refusal_for_illicit_intent as a provided concept (n014) to parallel safe_complete_strategy and enable clear linking to the illicit-intent examples, though none explicitly call on it in this span.

Left assume_best_intent_principle dangling: n019 demonstrates this principle (shown in example heading and good/bad comparison), but the principle is not explicitly established anywhere in this span—it appears only in the example frame. The span shows what it looks like but doesn't define it.
Created markdown_features_permitted and latex_math_formatting_requirements as provided concepts (n022, n023) because they are referenced by the example node (n024), allowing clean linkage.

Treated each of the 8 example blocks as single nodes (n003-n005, n011, n017-n019, n024) per the rule that example blocks are ONE node, never decomposed internally despite containing good/bad comparisons.

Line 4164 is blank or marks the start of a new section (L4163 heading continues outside the span). Covered L4163 separately (n025) to acknowledge the heading, then marked L4164 as uncovered since it's at the span boundary.
Did not split the commentary box (L4081-4082) into separate nodes: it's a meta-note about model behavior, not a rule or definition, so it gets one node (n016) as a factual statement.
